description: Call a per-use tool from an independent seller, by its listing id (from marketplace_search). The price is the listing's own, paid over x402 straight into the listing's split: 90% to the seller, 10% to IGNOREO. Not charged if the seller's tool fails.

body.description: JSON body for the seller's tool (POST tools); see its example_request

path.description: Optional sub-path after the listing's address

name: marketplace_call
title: Use a seller's tool
